entities.name: Robert Lewis Reid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Lewis Reid was an American Impressionist painter and muralist. His work tended to be very decorative, much of it centered on depiction of young women set among flowers. He later became known for his murals and designs in stained glass.
